displayIdentity.body: The Artemis trade erupts around Paul’s way. Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.” When he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.
